title: Software Engineering Intern - Summer 2025
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD program in Computer Science or related STEM field.
qualification: Pursuing CS or technical degree with experience in C++, C#, Java, or Python.
description: Work alongside full-time engineers on scalable enterprise systems, cloud technologies, and AI solutions across core Microsoft products.

title: Rhodes Scholarship 2025/2026
eligibility: Undergraduate degree completion prior to start; ages 18-24 (varies by constituency).
qualification: Bachelor degree with exceptional academic performance and demonstrated leadership.
description: Fully funded postgraduate award enabling outstanding young people from around the world to study at the University of Oxford.

title: AI Math & Coding Trainer
eligibility: Strong foundation in mathematics, computer science, or related quantitative disciplines.
qualification: Enrolled in or completed STEM degree; proficiency in Python, C++, or advanced mathematics.
description: Train generative AI models by writing solution rationales, evaluating AI-generated code, and creating high-quality STEM prompts.

title: Google Summer of Code (GSoC) 2025
eligibility: Open to post-secondary students and open-source development beginners aged 18+.
qualification: Basic programming skills and passion for open-source software contribution.
description: A global online program focused on bringing new contributors into open source software organizations through structured mentorship.

title: CS50: Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to anyone worldwide with internet access.
description: An entry-level course teaching algorithmic thinking and problem-solving using C, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

title: Associate Product Manager (APM) Program
location: Mountain View, CA / New York, NY
eligibility: Final-year students or recent graduates within 1-2 years of graduation.
qualification: BS or MS degree in Computer Science, engineering, or related technical field.
description: A two-year rotational leadership program designed to give early-career product managers hands-on experience guiding core Google products.
